title: Using Browser Developer Tools for Tailwind knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which principle is most useful when applying Using Browser Developer Tools for Tailwind?
options: It removes the need to understand HTML semantics, the CSS cascade or browser behavior.
It makes every interface responsive and accessible without testing.
It runs all utility classes as JavaScript in the browser.
reproduce a problem, inspect the built CSS and test output rather than guessing
questions.answer_key: reproduce a problem, inspect the built CSS and test output rather than guessing
questions.explanation: Using Browser Developer Tools for Tailwind is best understood through the syllabus topics: Inspecting computed properties, Finding the originating CSS rule, Viewing media and container conditions. Choose the technique deliberately and verify the result.

questions.prompt: Which workflow is strongest when working with using browser developer tools for tailwind?
options: Assume that starting a development server proves every page and state works.
Skip narrow-screen testing because utility-first CSS is automatically responsive.
use a minimal test case and confirm the production build and responsive states
Add classes until a screenshot looks acceptable without inspecting generated CSS.
questions.answer_key: use a minimal test case and confirm the production build and responsive states
questions.explanation: A reliable workflow checks generated CSS and the actual interface. Related topics include: Inspecting computed properties, Finding the originating CSS rule, Viewing media and container conditions, Inspecting layout geometry.

questions.prompt: Which common mistake should you avoid when applying using browser developer tools for tailwind?
options: Check keyboard states where controls are involved.
a successful development server does not prove production assets are complete
Document intended behavior and test representative content.
Use the official documentation for version-specific behavior.
questions.answer_key: a successful development server does not prove production assets are complete
questions.explanation: Good styling work is verified, version-aware and tested with realistic content and input methods.
